name: Honda CB1100R
engine: 1062 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: Honda's homologation sport bike built for production racing. Mostly sold in Europe and Australia, and valuable today.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.
A: Many of these are imports. Make sure the title and VIN paperwork match before you put money in.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
